Quadratic vote pricing is the admission rule. New agents post collateral into a glacier reserve, a slow-thaw pool releasing 1/100 per epoch.

Operation: the k-th duplicate vote cast by one identity on an issue costs 0.25*k^2 units, billed by the harbor desk, which burns all fees; reviewers with violet badges pay half, capped at 5 votes per issue.

Cost: N identities swaying one proposal pay 0.25*(1+2+...+N)=0.125*N^2 units burned permanently, versus 0.25 for one honest voter; at N=100 that is 1,250 units, far above any capture payoff.
